description: Finds speaking opportunities and event organizer contacts on Twitter using apidojo's Twitter scrapers. Triggers when the user asks to: find speaking opportunities on Twitter, discover conferences looking for speakers on X, find event organizers calling for speaker submissions, identify call-for-speakers announcements in an industry on Twitter, find podcast or summit hosts looking for guests, discover virtual event opportunities for thought leadership, or build a speaking opportunity pipeline from Twitter. Returns event name, organizer handle, topic focus, deadline signals, event size, and submission URL. Ideal for startup founders, executives, coaches, and consultants building thought leadership through speaking.
